name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: The angler fishing with Maggot belongs to the South Watershed.
Boone and Royce are in different watersheds.
Gus does not belong to the Sunfish Family.
Perch goes with exactly two of Mabel, Cedarmere, and Maggot.
Royce, Catfish, Willowmere, and Cricket belong to different catches.
The angler fishing with Maggot and Gus are in the same family.
The angler at Cedarmere and Royce are in the same family.
Trout goes with exactly one of Mossbank, Stillwater, or Shrimp.
